prompt:
Take the reference photograph and change ONE thing in it. Everything else
stays exactly as it is: the same view looking down at the pavement from the
same height, the same straight painted edge running down the picture, the
same bicycle strip painted a faded dusty brick red on the left with the same
white bicycle symbol on it, the same grey pavement slabs on the right, the
same beige chino trousers coming down into the frame.

THE ONE CHANGE: the man is standing further to the right. There is ONE pair
of shoes in the picture and he is wearing it: two white leather sneakers,
side by side, both soles flat ON THE GREY PAVEMENT SLABS, with the beige
chino trousers coming down into the frame above them. To their left, across
the painted edge, the red bicycle strip runs clear and open with only its
painted white bicycle symbol on it. Daylight, overcast and flat.
